notes.title: Version 1.4.3: Protect game saves
notes.notes:
Version 1.4.3 adds a pop up confirmation alert when attempting to start a new quest or arcade run if there is an in-progress game saved. This adds some protection, so an accidental button press won't delete your save file!

Also in this version - background music streams directly from file instead of being loaded into memory, so the game loads quicker 🐎💨

notes.title: Version 1.4.0: Achievement pop-ups
notes.notes:
Achievements pop-up at the top of the screen when unlocked. This is in addition to the Steam built-in achievement pop-up. Overall achievement progress can now be viewed on the title screen under the achievements menu!

Stats are also displayed on the title screen under their own stats menu. Do you want to know how many fish have killed you? Now you can find out.

There is also a much needed upgrade to fonts, both the font itself and the way the text is drawn. Menus, buttons, the scoreboard, and all text should look slightly better, especially when running with a small window size.

Thanks for playing Cakefoot in 2024, its first year. Looking forward to 2025! 🥳

notes.title: Version 1.3.0: Audio improvements
notes.notes: This update introduces new background music: unique medleys of VGM mixed with the Cakefoot theme music, one medley for each of the four chapters of the game. Sound effects have been buffed as well - sounds will pan to the left and right depending on where the character is on screen. Enjoy! 🎵🎶

notes.title: Version 1.2.1: Fix walking backward achievements
notes.notes: This fix prevents the walking backward achievements from triggering prematurely. If this bug affected you, see this method for resetting the achievement using the Steam console -- or leave a message here and I will reset it. ːenteringsteamvrː

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Achievements and stats
notes.notes:
Achievements and stats are finally live!

There are 39 achievements to collect and 21 stats to track. Some achievements introduce new challenges to the game like walking backward or walking without letting go of the button, while others are based on logging in for consecutive days or on certain dates. ːsteamsunnyː

A full announcement will come next week if this build can be confirmed to be running stably.

Another small update in this version is the ability to save fullscreen, bgm and sfx preferences.

Version 1.2 introduces a lot of automated tests to the build system to help prevent crashes - but since this is still a large update with a lot of changes to the game engine, there is a good chance there will be issues such as achievements not triggering. Feedback or bug reports on the discussion board or emailed to cocktail.frank@dank.game are much appreciated.

Please enjoy, and thank you for playing Cakefoot ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.1.4: prevent crashes from corrupt save data
notes.notes:
If the save data file becomes corrupt, like if the power dies during a save operation or a new bug in the program happens, the game is now able to start without crashing.

Unfortunately, the save data will not be recovered (that feature will be added in a future update). If your save data is corrupted, email me at cocktail.frank at dank.game and I will provide a save file to restore your data.

notes.title: Version 1.1.3: Bug fixes, and logging disabled
notes.notes:
This is a bug fix update that may slightly improve performance. Logging is also disabled by default (it can be enabled by editing config.json).

 Remove all calls to `glGetError`
 Disable logging by defaultThank you for playing Cakefoot! New features are being planned for version 1.2 ːenteringsteamvrː

notes.title: Version 1.1.2: add version string to pause menu
notes.notes:
Small update to help identify technical issues ⚙


Add version string to pause menu
Enable vsync
Now you can get the version of Cakefoot from the pause menu by clicking the gear or pressing ESC during gameplay. Contact me at cocktail.frank@dank.game if you are experiencing issues with the game, technical or otherwise, and let me know the version and platform you're using!

notes.title: Version 1.1.1: fix arcade mode bug
notes.notes: The bank HUD upgrade introduced a bug preventing arcade mode from running because it was looking for an old save progress field called "arcade coin". This update removes the "arcade coin" field entirely in favor of the new bank save progress field.

notes.title: Update to 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Fixes a couple of bugs introduced in 1.0.5.

Prevent the coin HUD from being transformed in the display effects modes.Fix a bug which loaded the wrong level's coin bank status when resuming a game saved at a checkpointFuture updates will use the last digit for bug fixes and minor changes and the second digit for new features or other major updates.

notes.title: Update to corrected Linux build for Ubuntu-18 instead of Debian-Testing
notes.notes: This replaces the Linux testing build with the Ubuntu-18 build which has wider compatibility

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 released!
notes.notes:
Notable improvements to input support include:
 New dynamic UI that switches between gamepad and mouse modes automatically
Ability to add a gamepad or switch to a different gamepad while the game is running
Support for either D-pad or analog stick
Improved visibility of selected button in gamepad mode
Home button pauses the game before the Steam interface is launchedFurther upgrades for better Steam input support and gamepad customization are planned 😺👍
